title: Chapter 204 Lu Xue Will Solve It
content:
Chapter 204 Lu Xue Will Solve It

People from the Central Region?

Lu Daosheng looked a little puzzled. Someone from the Central Region would come to him at this time.

Has his fame spread to the Central Region so quickly?

Then, Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

"Let them in."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Not long after Xun Heng left, he slowly walked into the hall with two old men.

One was an old man with white eyebrows, and the other was an old man with long hair.

"I have heard for a long time that the Lord of the Wasteland City has great cultivation and unparalleled combat power. Today, I see that he is indeed extraordinary."

As soon as they entered the hall, the two old men complimented Lu Daosheng.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but smile.

"You two have come from afar. I wonder what you are doing in my Wasteland City?"

Looking at the two people, Lu Daosheng smiled.

Seeing Lu Daosheng asking directly, the two old men looked at each other, and then the old man with white eyebrows stepped forward and said: "Lord Huang, I am from the Xiao Clan in the Central Region, Xiao Chen, and the one next to me is my fellow clansman, Xiao Xuanmu."

On the side, Xiao Xuanmu nodded to Lu Daosheng.

At this time, Lu Daosheng was about to speak, but Yan Lingyun on the side suddenly said: "The Xiao Clan you are talking about, is it the Xiao Clan, one of the ancient immortal clans?"

Hearing Yan Lingyun's words, the two Xiao clan members were suddenly a little surprised.

Unexpectedly, the woman in front of them actually recognized the identity of their ancient Xiao Clan.

"Yes, it is."

Xiao Chen did not hide his identity and nodded to admit it.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun nodded slightly.

On the side, Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun and said: "Lingyun, do you know this ancient immortal clan?"

Seeing that Lu Daosheng didn't understand, Yan Lingyun explained: "The ancient immortal clan is the descendants of the first four strong men who entered the Central Region of the Immortal Realm that year."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng immediately understood.

"So, what exactly is the reason you came to see me in my Desolate City?"

At this time, Xiao Chen and Yan Lingyun looked at each other again, and then looked at Lu Xue and Wan Feng beside Lu Daosheng, the meaning was self-evident.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

"There are no outsiders here."

Seeing Lu Daosheng's face change, Xiao Chen didn't dare to say anything, and hurriedly said: "Lord of the Desolate City, the two of us came to the Desolate City, hoping to join the Desolate City and get your help."

"My help?"

Xiao Chen nodded, "Lord of the Desolate City, I won't hide it, now, my Xiao clan will be in danger of extinction."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun were both a little surprised.

I thought this ancient fairy clan was very powerful, but I didn't expect it to be exterminated in a blink of an eye.

"It's not impossible to get my help, but just the two of you joining my Desolate City is not worthy of me doing it myself."

Hearing this, Xiao Chen and Xiao Xuanmu's faces changed.

Although he had guessed this would happen, he still couldn't help but feel sad.

"Lord Huang, as long as you can save our Xiao clan, our Xiao clan is willing to offer everything of our Xiao clan."

After a moment of silence, Xiao Chen seemed to have made some important decision, gritted his teeth and said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, Xiao Xuanmu's face changed drastically.

"Xiao Chen, you!"

However, Xiao Chen said solemnly: "I don't want to watch the Xiao clan go to extinction step by step."

Looking at Xiao Chen's serious expression, Xiao Xuanmu didn't want to do this, but he didn't say anything.

Then, the two looked at Lu Daosheng above.

At this time, Lu Daosheng was also thinking about the pros and cons of this matter.

In front of him, everything is not difficult, but the key is whether he wants to do it, and what benefits it can bring to himself or the people around him.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng turned his head to look at Yan Lingyun.

"Lingyun, what do you think?"

Yan Lingyun's face was calm, "I don't know."

"Uh,"

Lu Daosheng turned to look at his daughter Lu Xue again.

"Xiaoxue, what do you think?"

Hearing her father ask her, Lu Xue was flattered.

Then, Lu Xue pretended to think for a moment, and slowly said: "Dad, I think I can help them, but this matter is not trivial. If you go in person, it will make my Huangcheng look faceless, so you can send a very trusted, preferably a respected person to solve this matter."

Hearing their daughter's serious analysis, Lu Daosheng and his wife's face suddenly brightened.

"Xiaoxue, who do you mean to send?"

Lu Xue coughed lightly.

"Well, why not let me go."

Lu Xue patted her huge chest and said confidently: "If I go, there will be no problem."

......

Suddenly, the hall became quiet.

Everyone looked at Lu Xue, which made Lu Xue a little embarrassed.

"Uh, why are you looking at me like that?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng sighed, waved his hand and said, "Xiaoxue, stop making trouble, go down and play."

Below, Mu Chen and the others also smiled awkwardly.

"Your daughter is quite humorous."

At this time, Lu Xue's cultivation was only in the middle stage of the Immortal King. It was too dangerous to go to the Central Region with such strength.

However, Lu Xue didn't care, "Dad, you can't look down on me like this."

Unfortunately, Lu Daosheng ignored him.

Seeing this, Lu Xue stomped her feet and ran to Yan Lingyun's side.

"Mom, Dad doesn't believe me, but you will definitely believe me, right?"

Lu Xue blinked her big eyes and acted coquettishly to Yan Lingyun.

When he was a child, he had not stayed by Lu Xue to take care of Lu Xue, which made Yan Lingyun feel very guilty towards Lu Xue, and now he will naturally face Lu Xue.

"Mom believes in you, you are my daughter, how could you say you don't believe it?"

Touching Lu Xue's head, Yan Lingyun said with a kind smile on her face.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue's expression lit up.

"Well, did you agree to me?"

Yan Lingyun nodded slightly.

Seeing this, Lu Xue was immediately excited, "Thank you, you're the best!"

On the side, Lu Daosheng said something first, but he looked at Yan Lingyun and didn't know how to speak.

And Mu Chen and the others below were stunned.

Although their Xiao clan has declined, they will not be able to be saved by a cultivator who has fallen to the realm of Immortal King.

Even if the other party has an extraordinary identity, it won’t work.

"Lord of the Wilderness City, this,"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng also frowned slightly, "Why, do you look down on my daughter?"

"No, no, Lord Huang City, I have no intention of this."

"It's just that this matter is a bit dangerous, and I'm afraid that Ai will suffer some harm."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was about to speak, when Lu Xue stepped forward and said, "I'm not afraid, don't worry, you Xiao clan, I, Lu Xue, have saved me."

At this moment, Xiao Chen and the others felt more uncomfortable than crying.

He obviously came to ask Lord Huang for help.

Even the wife of the Lord of Huang City is fine.

The result is that the other party’s daughter comes.

What's the matter?

Finally, Xiao Chen and the others walked out of the main hall of the City Lord's Mansion with disappointed expressions.

"What should I do?"

Xiao Xuanmu said dullly.

Xiao Chen sighed, "Let's take a step by step. That woman is the daughter of a person like the Lord of the Huang City, but her cultivation is a little lower."

Of course, this is just a self-comfort.

If Lu Xue can save them, she won’t believe that they can kill them.

And inside the hall.

"Xiaoxue, be careful when you go to Zhongyu. Your parents won't send anyone to follow you."

"Don't worry, mom, I can do it."

Lu Xue was full of confidence. She wanted to prove to her parents that she could stand alone.

After Lu Xue left, Wan Feng hesitated and said, "Master, Master, is it too dangerous to let Xiaoxue go alone? Why don't you let me follow me secretly?"

Since Lu Daosheng and the others returned, Wan Feng’s name for Lu Xue has changed from Miss to Xiaoxue.

This makes you look closer.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng thought, while Yan Lingyun said in a low voice: "You are right. Xiaoxue is indeed a bit dangerous, but Huangcheng cannot be without you now. I have someone to protect Xiaoxue. select."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng and Wan Feng asked at the same time: "Who?"

Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Daosheng.

"You, you have nothing to do."

Lu Daosheng:...

"Then I might as well solve it myself."

Lu Daosheng said speechlessly.

However, Yan Lingyun snorted coldly, "Who told you not to make a decision by yourself? You have to ask Xiaoxue."

"If something happens to Xiaoxue, you won't come back."

Yan Lingyun stepped forward and pinched Lu Daosheng, then left the hall.

Seeing Lu Daosheng stunned in place, Wan Feng stepped forward and said weakly, "Master, please do your own thing."

Immediately, Wan Feng also left the hall.

Standing there, Lu Daosheng sighed heavily.

What's the matter with this?
